title.en: A new pill (CX11) for type 2 diabetes not controlled by metformin
title.es: Una nueva pastilla (CX11) para la diabetes tipo 2 no controlada con metformina
title.pt: Um novo comprimido (CX11) para diabetes tipo 2 não controlado com metformina
title.ht: Yon nouvo grenn (CX11) pou dyabèt tip 2 ki pa kontwole ak metfòmin
title.zh: 一种用于二甲双胍控制不佳的2型糖尿病新药片（CX11）
title.vi: Một viên thuốc mới (CX11) cho bệnh tiểu đường loại 2 không kiểm soát được bằng metformin

summary.en: This study tests a new pill called CX11 for people with type 2 diabetes whose blood sugar is still high on metformin. Some people get CX11 and some get a placebo pill. Treatment lasts 24 weeks.
summary.es: Este estudio prueba una nueva pastilla llamada CX11 para personas con diabetes tipo 2 cuyo azúcar sigue alto con metformina. Algunas personas reciben CX11 y otras una pastilla sin medicamento. El tratamiento dura 24 semanas.
summary.pt: Este estudo testa um novo comprimido chamado CX11 para pessoas com diabetes tipo 2 cujo açúcar continua alto com metformina. Algumas pessoas recebem CX11 e outras um comprimido sem remédio. O tratamento dura 24 semanas.
summary.ht: Etid sa a teste yon nouvo grenn ki rele CX11 pou moun ki gen dyabèt tip 2 ki gen sik ki toujou wo ak metfòmin. Gen moun ki resevwa CX11, gen lòt ki resevwa yon grenn san medikaman. Tretman an dire 24 semèn.
summary.zh: 本研究测试一种名为CX11的新药片，适用于服用二甲双胍后血糖仍高的2型糖尿病患者。部分人使用CX11，部分人使用安慰剂药片。治疗持续24周。
summary.vi: Nghiên cứu này thử nghiệm một viên thuốc mới tên CX11 cho người bị tiểu đường loại 2 vẫn còn đường huyết cao khi dùng metformin. Một số người nhận CX11, một số nhận viên giả dược. Điều trị kéo dài 24 tuần.

plain.en: This study is open to all sexes.
plain.es: Este estudio está abierto a todos los sexos.

checks.sourceText: Diagnosis of type 2 diabetes for at least 6 months.

plain.en: You have had type 2 diabetes for at least 6 months.
plain.es: Tiene diabetes tipo 2 desde hace al menos 6 meses.

plain.en: Your HbA1c (3-month blood sugar test) is 7% to 10.5%.
plain.es: Su HbA1c (prueba de azúcar de 3 meses) está entre 7% y 10.5%.

checks.sourceText: Body mass index (BMI) between 23 and 50 kg/m².

plain.en: Your body mass index (BMI) is 23 to 50.
plain.es: Su índice de masa corporal (IMC) está entre 23 y 50.

checks.sourceText: Stable dose of metformin (≥1000 mg/day), with or without SGLT2i, for ≥3 months.

Anticipated initiation or change in concomitant medications (for more than 14 consecutive days) known to affect weight or glucose metabolism (e.g. treatment with orlistat, thyroid hormones, or systemic corticosteroids).

plain.en: You are not starting or changing steroids or thyroid medicine.
plain.es: No está comenzando ni cambiando esteroides o medicamento para la tiroides.

checks.sourceText: Type 1 diabetes or a history of diabetic ketoacidosis.

plain.en: You cannot join if you have type 1 diabetes.
plain.es: No puede participar si tiene diabetes tipo 1.

checks.sourceText: Use of any GLP-1 receptor agonist within the past 6 months, or any prior exposure to CX11.

plain.en: You have not used a GLP-1 medicine in the last 6 months.
plain.es: No ha usado un medicamento GLP-1 en los últimos 6 meses.

checks.sourceText: Use of insulin to control blood sugar within the past 12 months.

plain.en: You have not used insulin in the last 12 months.
plain.es: No ha usado insulina en los últimos 12 meses.

checks.sourceText: More than one episode of severe low blood sugar, with awareness of hypoglycemia symptoms.

plain.en: You have not had more than one severe low blood sugar episode.
plain.es: No ha tenido más de un episodio de azúcar muy baja en la sangre.

checks.sourceText: Cardiovascular or cerebrovascular conditions within the past 6 months: Heart attack, coronary angioplasty, or bypass surgery; valvular heart disease; unstable angina; transient ischemic attack (TIA) or stroke; decompensated heart failure (NYHA Class III or IV).

plain.en: You have not had a heart attack or stroke in the last 6 months.
plain.es: No ha tenido un ataque al corazón o derrame en los últimos 6 meses.

checks.sourceText: Pancreatic or gallbladder conditions: Acute or chronic pancreatitis.
Personal or first-degree family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma or multiple endocrine neoplasia (MEN) type 2A or 2B.

plain.en: No one in your family has had a rare thyroid cancer (MTC or MEN2).
plain.es: Nadie en su familia ha tenido un cáncer de tiroides raro (MTC o MEN2).

checks.sourceText: Malignancy within the past 5 years, regardless of recurrence or metastasis. Exceptions: localized basal cell skin cancer, low-risk prostate cancer, cervical carcinoma in situ, or high-grade prostatic intraepithelial neoplasia.

plain.en: You have not been treated for most cancers in the last 5 years.
plain.es: No ha recibido tratamiento para la mayoría de los cánceres en los últimos 5 años.

checks.sourceText: Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis, or other inflammatory bowel diseases.

plain.en: You cannot join if you have Crohn's disease or ulcerative colitis.
plain.es: No puede participar si tiene enfermedad de Crohn o colitis ulcerosa.

checks.sourceText: Chronic active hepatitis B or C.

plain.en: You cannot join if you have active hepatitis B or C.
plain.es: No puede participar si tiene hepatitis B o C activa.

plain.en: Your kidneys work well enough (eGFR 60 or higher).
plain.es: Sus riñones funcionan lo suficiente (eGFR de 60 o más).
